title: Pod membership: per-period roster snapshots + add/remove
description: Make pod membership mutable via per-period snapshots (Option B). Replace fixed Pod.members with versioned rosters (fromPeriod => members); settlement/votes/quorum for period P use the roster in force during P. Add addMember/removeMember (admin=creator, effective next period, min 2 members). Track periodContributors explicitly so refunds go to actual contributors regardless of roster. Period-scope commit/log/vote gating. Redeploy + update MCP (membersOf(period), currentPeriod, mast_pod_add_member/remove_member) + tests + docs.

title: Rename week→period throughout CommitmentEscrowV2
description: Pod period is now configurable, so week-based names are misnomers. Rename: resolveWeek→resolvePeriod, voteWeek→votePeriod, voteWeekSplit→votePeriodSplit, weekOf→periodOf, weekEnd→periodEnd, refundWeek→refundPeriod, weekResolved→periodResolved, events WeekResolved/WeekRefunded→PeriodResolved/PeriodRefunded, Pod.weekZero→periodZero, Pod.weeklyMinutes→targetMinutes. Keep 'period' for the index param, 'periodLength'/Pod.period for the duration. Update tests, smoke script, README.

title: Gasless transactions via paymaster (Account Abstraction)
description:
Deliver the gasless UX promised in the design docs (docs/01-strategic-vision.md, 02-platform-plan.md, 03-design-spec.md: 'gasless via Coinbase Paymaster, users never need ETH'). Today the MCP signs every tx with a plain EOA (new ethers.Wallet) and pays gas in ETH — no paymaster exists in the implementation. A fresh wallet with zero ETH can run mast_setup but its first commit reverts on gas. Docs now warn about this (commit 2a41efa) but the real fix is sponsored/USDC gas.

KEY DECISION — identity model. The escrow contracts (V1 solo + V2 pod) use raw msg.sender for identity (balances[msg.sender], commitment.user, pod membership). Two routes:
 (A) ERC-4337 smart account + sponsored bundler/paymaster: msg.sender becomes the smart-account address, consistent across all calls, so NO contract change. But the smart account has a DIFFERENT address than today's EOA — existing users have USDC in the contracts under their EOA address, so needs a migration story (keep EOA for existing users, smart accounts for new; or a one-time move).
 (B) ERC-2771 trusted-forwarder meta-tx (relayer pays gas): requires redeploying the contracts with ERC2771Context/_msgSender() support (current contracts don't have it) + a relayer. Contract change + migration.
Recommend (A) for new users; keep EOA path working for existing ones.

PROVIDER OPTIONS (all keep 'USDC only, no ETH'):
 - Coinbase CDP Paymaster + Bundler on Base (matches the design docs' Coinbase Onramp direction; needs CDP API key + sponsorship policy).
 - Pimlico ERC-20 (USDC) paymaster on Base — pay gas in USDC directly; good fit since users already hold USDC.
 - Alchemy/Biconomy AA stacks as alternates.

PREREQUISITE REFACTOR: unify tx submission behind one seam. There are 17 write call-sites in mast-mcp/index.js (escrow.deposit/withdraw/commit/complete/expire/createPod/addMember/removeMember/commitPod/logProgress/votePeriod/votePeriodSplit/resolvePeriod/refundPeriod/setForfeitPlan/clearForfeitPlan/transferPodAdmin + usdc.approve) plus sendPodTx/ensureAvailable/commitWithRetry. Route them all through a single submitWrite(config, contract, method, args) that dispatches EOA-send today or UserOp-send when AA is enabled.

PHASES:
 0. Spike: choose stack (Coinbase CDP vs Pimlico USDC paymaster) + smart-account lib (permissionless.js / CDP SDK). Decide migration story. Test on Base Sepolia.
 1. PoC: one sponsored write (deposit) end-to-end gasless on Sepolia.
 2. Refactor: unified submitWrite seam; move all 17 sites onto it (behavior-identical on EOA path).
 3. Wire AA: smart-account creation in mast_setup (config gets accountType, smart-account address, bundler/paymaster endpoints/keys), UserOp build+sign+submit, receipt/retry parity with sendPodTx.
 4. Roll out on mainnet; soften the ETH requirement in mast_setup/mast_fund/README once sponsored gas is proven.

ACCEPTANCE: a brand-new wallet with 0 ETH can complete setup -> fund USDC -> commit -> complete with zero ETH, on mainnet, via the MCP. Existing EOA users keep working unchanged.

NOTE: large, multi-phase; not a blocker (the ETH-for-gas docs mitigate onboarding for now). Relates to the just-shipped ETH note in mast_fund/mast_setup/README.

title: settle.js: auto-expire overdue pod stakes
description: Members currently expire their own missed pod stakes via mast_pod_expire. Extend the nightly settle daemon to scan the V2 pod contract's Committed/Expired events (or local pods.json across members) and auto-expire overdue unsettled pod stakes so pools fund without manual action, then auto-resolve ended periods where a majority split vote exists.

title: Wire mast_pod_* MCP tools
description: Expose pod mode via MCP: mast_pod_create, mast_pod_commit, mast_pod_log_progress, mast_pod_vote, mast_pod_resolve, plus mast_set_forfeit_plan for solo forfeit routing. Blocked on final contract address after redeploy.

title: Pod messaging: Telegram/WhatsApp notify
description: Implement mast-mcp/pod-notify.js stub: notify(pod,event) fans out to configured channels for progress/expiry/resolution. Config in ~/.mast/pod-notify.json.
